# #4507: Patch: remove the accessibility statement page (/accessibility)
Opened by @MaxGoetzmann.

## What

The owner wants the public accessibility statement page, `/accessibility`, removed from the site. It came in with #757 (launch compliance). Take it out completely: the route, its chunk, its document title, its footer link, its command-menu entry, its sitemap, static-page and `_redirects` entries, its translations, its tests and the docs that point at it. `/accessibility` should then draw the client's `NotFound` like any unknown path. #4037 removed `/ai` the same way (PR #4043, R4037000), so follow that precedent.

**CLAUDE.md rule 13:** `/accessibility` is a public route that people can visit. A person asked for this removal directly, so the bot does not need to stop and ask.

**Keep the accessibility *checks*.** This removes only the statement page. `e2e/cypress/e2e/38-accessibility.cy.ts` (axe-core over every route), `e2e/support/a11y.ts`, `e2e/support/axe-exceptions.ts` and the keyboard-play test all stay. Only their mentions of the page change.

## Where it lives (from a grep of `main`)

- `apps/web/src/routes/accessibility.tsx`: the page (`AccessibilityRoute`, `accessibilityTestid`, `ACCESSIBILITY_LAST_UPDATED`). Delete it.
- `apps/web/src/net/navigate.ts:250`: `paths.accessibility`.
- `apps/web/src/main.tsx:134` and `:758`: `AccessibilityRoute` and its dispatch.
- `apps/web/src/routes/chunks.tsx:79`: the lazy chunk.
- `apps/web/src/net/head.ts:33-34`: the "Accessibility" title.
- `apps/web/src/routes/SiteFooter.tsx`: the footer link (around lines 52-56), `siteFooterTestid.accessibility`, and the header comments (lines 2 and 6) that name the page.
- `apps/web/src/routes/commandEntries.ts:75`: the `page-accessibility` command-menu entry.
- `apps/web/static-pages.ts`: the `PUBLIC_PAGES` entry (around line 65), the `PAGE_TEXT[paths.accessibility]` block (around line 221), and the header comment at line 90.
- `apps/web/public/_redirects:27`: `/accessibility /accessibility/ 200`. `deploy-routes.test.ts` checks `_redirects` against `paths`, so remove both together.
- `apps/web/src/i18n/zh-CN.json`: the page's strings (e.g. line 936, "We want JackiOh to be usable…"). Remove every entry that only the page used, and keep any that other code still uses, such as a shared label.
- Tests that list the page:
  - `apps/web/src/routes/privacy.test.tsx`: the header comment, the `AccessibilityRoute` import, the updated-date test (around line 198), the `accessibility.tsx` entry in the file loop (around line 225), the sitemap assertion (around line 234), the "no account needed" test (around line 291), the footer assertion (around line 312) and the title assertion (around line 369).
  - `apps/web/src/static-pages.test.ts`: the import (line 44) and the quote-check row (around line 363).
  - `apps/web/src/routes/page-titles.test.tsx`: the import (line 10) and its row.
  - `apps/web/src/routes/engine-gate.test.tsx:150`: `["/accessibility", "accessibility-screen"]`.
  - `apps/web/src/routes/chunks.test.tsx:251-272`: the prefetch test spies on `routeChunks.accessibility`. Repoint it at another footer page, such as `/copyright` or `/terms`, so the test still covers what it is about.
  - `apps/web/src/routes/command-menu.test.tsx:167`: `"page-accessibility"`.
  - `e2e/cypress/e2e/38-accessibility.cy.ts`: `SCREEN.accessibility` (line 66) and the `it("/accessibility")` block (lines 211-213).
- `e2e/support/axe-exceptions.ts:3-4`: the comment says `/accessibility` lists the same gaps for players. Reword it so it doesn't point at the page.
- `docs/compliance.md`: §1 (line 15) lists `/accessibility` among the pages that name `CONTACT_EMAIL`, so drop it there. §3 says to write Lighthouse findings into `/accessibility` and that `/accessibility` says what was checked. Rewrite §3 so it keeps the axe-core check and drops the page. Grep for any other mention.
- `spec/rulings/R2631000.md` says `/ai` sat "beside `/accessibility`". That note is historical and already amended, so leave it unless `spec check` flags it.

## The ruling

No ruling note owns `/accessibility` today. Record the removal as a new ruling in this issue's block, numbered by CLAUDE.md rule 3, in the shape of `R4037000.md`:
- It should say that the owner asked for `/accessibility` to be removed, and list what went.
- It should say that the axe-core checks stay.
- It should say that the path now draws `NotFound`.
- Under "Rejected", it should name a stub page or a redirect.

Put its §11 paragraph in `spec/pending/<N>.md`. Back it with a proving test in the style of `apps/web/src/routes/ai-removed.test.tsx`: `/accessibility` is in neither `PUBLIC_PAGES` nor `PAGE_TEXT`, the sitemap, the footer or the command menu, and the path draws `NotFound` with the same title as any unknown path.

## Acceptance

- `/accessibility` no longer renders the page and behaves like any other unknown path.
- The site footer and the command menu have no Accessibility entry.
- `/accessibility` appears in none of the sitemap, `static-pages.ts`, `_redirects` or the zh-CN dictionary.
- `docs/compliance.md` no longer points at the page, and still describes the axe-core check.
- `38-accessibility.cy.ts` still runs axe over every remaining route.
- These pass: `cargo jackioh spec check`, `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`, `pnpm --dir apps/web test`, `pnpm exec eslint apps/web apps/edge apps/admin e2e`, and e2e's `typecheck`.
- The change ships no card data, so no patch fragment should be needed. Confirm this with `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims`.
